mechanism: Systemic corticosteroids can increase bone resorption and may enhance bisphosphonate-related risks including osteonecrosis of the jaw and atypical fractures; ophthalmic prednisolone has minimal systemic absorption but cumulative glucocorticoid effects are possible with concurrent zoledronic acid.
action: Monitor for signs of osteonecrosis of the jaw and atypical fractures; ensure adequate dental hygiene; consider alternative topical anti-inflammatory if prolonged prednisolone ophthalmic use is anticipated.
